This advice is part of the helpful and supportive communication between the two characters, as seen in the interactions within the provided data tables. By recommending a specific and practical solution, Adam Smith ensures that Li Hua can decorate her space safely and effectively. This recommendation is evident from the exchange in the csv content where Li Hua expresses her interest in hanging artwork, and Adam Smith promptly responds with the appropriate advice:
